# DeepAI

> DeepAI is a comprehensive AI creative platform offering text-to-image, video, music generation, photo editing, and detection tools for creators and developers.

DeepAI provides both web-based creative tools and API access for developers to integrate AI-powered generation and editing capabilities. The platform serves content creators, designers, and developers with subscription plans and pay-as-you-go options.

## Key Topics

- AI Image Generator
- AI Video Generator
- AI Music Generator
- AI Photo Editor
- DeepAI Pro
- Text-to-Image
- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- Music Generation
- AI Image Detector
- Super Resolution API
- Image Editing
- Background Removal
- Creative AI
- AI Platform

## Creative Generation Tools

- [AI Image Generator](https://deepai.org/machine-learning-model/text2img): DeepAI's text-to-image AI generator with style selection and editing tools.
- [AI Video Generator](https://deepai.org/video): DeepAI's text-to-video and image-to-video AI generator with Hollywood Mode.
- [AI Music Generator](https://deepai.org/music): DeepAI's music generator for foley, sound effects, and background tracks.

## Image & Photo Tools

- [AI Photo Editor](https://deepai.org/machine-learning-model/image-editor): DeepAI's AI-powered photo editor with background removal and enhancement.
- [Super Resolution](https://deepai.org/machine-learning-model/torch-srgan): DeepAI's Super Resolution API for image upscaling and enhancement.
- [Image Replace](https://deepai.org/image-replace): DeepAI's Image Replace tool for AI-powered object removal and editing.
- [AI Image Detector](https://deepai.org/ai-image-detector): DeepAI's free AI Image Detector for identifying deepfakes and synthetic media.

## Developer Resources

- [DeepAI Docs](https://deepai.org/docs): DeepAI documentation for APIs and tools including Image Generator and Chat.

## Reference & Learning

- [Data Science & AI Glossary](https://deepai.org/definitions): AI and machine learning glossary covering NLP, computer vision, and deep learning.
- [AI Humanizer](https://deepai.org/ai-humanizer): DeepAI's AI Humanizer tool for converting AI text to human-sounding content.

- [Pricing](https://deepai.org/pricing): DeepAI Pro pricing with subscription plans and pay-as-you-go options.
